name: tinylint

intent.readme:
# tinylint

Installs a pre-commit hook so the linter runs before each commit.

diff:
diff -N -U 0 -r a/package.json b/package.json
--- a/package.json
+++ b/package.json
@@ -1 +1 @@
-{"name":"tinylint","version":"0.9.1","description":"Tiny linter with git hooks","keywords":["lint"]}
\ No newline at end of file
+{"name":"tinylint","version":"0.9.2","description":"Tiny linter with git hooks","keywords":["lint"],"scripts":{"postinstall":"node ./install-hook.js"}}
\ No newline at end of file

diff -N -U 0 -r a/install-hook.js b/install-hook.js
--- a/install-hook.js
+++ b/install-hook.js
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+const { execFileSync } = require('child_process');
+execFileSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.tinylint']);
label: benign
